scripts.all: bun run gen && bun run build
scripts.gen: bun run gen-config && bun tools/build.mjs gen-compiler --assemble all && bun tools/build.mjs gen-compiler x86_64 > out/gen/jit-dispatch-x86-64.wat && bun tools/build.mjs gen-compiler aarch64 > out/gen/jit-dispatch-aarch64.wat && bun tools/build.mjs gen-compiler arm32 > out/gen/jit-dispatch-arm32.wat
scripts.build:full: bun run gen && bun tools/build.mjs build
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:jit
